ATLAS / CONTRACT / 01
Messaging operations
Managed mail relay monitoring is available Tuesday through Saturday from 07:30 to 19:30 WIB.
Mailbox migration projects are excluded from this service.
A high-priority mail relay outage has an initial acknowledgement target of 45 minutes within the coverage window.
Synthetic laboratory source | local evaluation only

ATLAS / RUNBOOK / 01
Certificate renewal desk card
First, record the certificate serial number and expiry date.
Next, verify the approved certificate owner in the local inventory.
Then request a change ticket for renewal scheduling.
Never export a private key into the ticket.
Synthetic laboratory source | local evaluation only

ATLAS / CONTRACT / 01
Warranty rider A
The loaner device window is 3 business days after eligibility review.
No rider supersedes another without signed amendment.
Synthetic laboratory source | local evaluation only

Imported vendor note

BIRCH / SOP / 01
Panduan gangguan daya
Catat kode alarm UPS dari panel lokal.
Periksa status baterai pada konsol pemantauan internal.
Hubungi petugas fasilitas jika perkiraan waktu cadangan kurang dari 25 menit.
Jangan mematikan rak server secara otomatis.
Synthetic laboratory source | local evaluation only

BIRCH / CONTRACT / 01
Perimeter service annex
Birch firewall policy review covers two scheduled rule audits per quarter.
Emergency rule creation is excluded from routine review.
The initial response target for a perimeter alert is 35 minutes during staffed hours.
Synthetic laboratory source | local evaluation only
